title: Law to require training on rent freeze programs for city staff
summary: This bill would expand New York City's rent freeze program rules to add the Disability Rent Increase Exemption program and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities as a participating agency. It would require the Department of Finance to train designated staff at participating agencies annually, starting by June 30, 2027, on eligibility, applications, accommodations and referrals. The Department of Finance would also have to report annually to the Council on these trainings, starting October 1, 2027.
